title: Covered perils
text: Homeowners policies cover water damage, theft and fire. Auto policies cover collision, theft and liability. Other perils require investigation.

title: Per-claim policy limit
text: A claim amount must not exceed the policy's per-claim limit. Equality is covered but may trigger the near-limit review pattern.

title: Active coverage period
text: The loss date must lie between active_from and active_to inclusive. Report date alone does not establish coverage.

title: Early policy claim
text: Claims reported within 7 days of policy inception, including day 7, require investigator review regardless of amount. A report before inception requires review as well.

title: Near-limit amount
text: Covered claim amounts within 2 percent of the policy limit, including exactly 98 percent, warrant investigator review. Above-limit claims already fail the limit check.

title: Repeated similar flagged losses
text: A similar peril on the same policy with an earlier flagged loss within the preceding 365 days warrants investigator review. History is an indicator, never proof of fraud.

title: Delayed reporting
text: Losses reported more than 30 days after the loss require supporting documentation before an adjuster decides.

title: Human review and synthetic scope
text: All outcomes are synthetic recommendations for an adjuster. Validation failures or service failures require more documentation. Coverage failures or anomaly patterns route to an investigator. Clean evidence permits an auto approve recommendation, pending a human decision. Never accuse a policyholder of fraud.
